objective: PTT voice/transcription correctness and in-app non-exclusive video audio mixing during PTT receive, without changing mic/floor/native behavior
acceptanceChecks: TypeScript and backend API contract tests
Stage Edge Function deployment only after backend verification
In-app Wall/Reels/Ads video audioMixingMode is nonexclusive
Audio coexistence on external apps cannot be guaranteed without Android device/SDK acceptance
Exact head Android and Expo web compiled RC artifact exists (NO PUBLISH)
productionBaselineEvidence: Inspected GitHub main source 1dfe6e3da1ef569916f43607067e0a29e4d29bbb before changes; installed Android OTA fingerprint and real device audio coexistence not independently verified. Draft PR is DEV only.
chosenApproach: Preserve existing Stream PTT mic/floor/priority stack while giving Expo videos nonexclusive mixing; separate call-wide captions from member transcript consent; specify Tagalog/English language; use 5-second caption segments; isolate message refresh failures.
selectionRationale: Voice PTT already works. Changing native Stream audio-role or forcing media pauses would risk talk/receive and require an APK. Nonexclusive video mode is an additive JS-side improvement while keeping backend caption changes behind release gates.
alternativeApproaches: Switch Stream callManager to listener role (rejected: jeopardizes microphone transmission and requires role switching)
Force-pause/resume other media whenever PTT connects (rejected: violates owner request)
Change native AudioManager audio focus in existing APK (deferred: cannot be shipped as JS-only OTA)
